cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of W234: pits P93 and P94 sit 1 m off the moved pipe, so the record cannot name them (must FAIL on a check)
cases.expected: Same checks as W234. P93 and P94 are 1 m south of where the pipe lands, so after the MOVE the record names no P93 or P94 and the case FAILS on the from=P93 checks and the Edit Pipe Flow checks.
cases.why_not_unit: The pipe record is rewritten by CE's relink when AutoCAD ends the native MOVE and STRETCH commands on the live drawing.
cases.blocked: v2 HARD TIMEOUT: AutoCAD did not answer in time (a tool or load problem, not a result)
